row.notes: Shared filler for all six RnD upgrade telemetry events. Finds the local player entrant in the career (module+0x209c0 -> +0x88 -> +0x260, list +0x2e0) and returns 0 unless evt+0x10 team id equals the player team. Otherwise writes into the upgrade sub-message: three enum name strings from the upgrade definition evt+0x18 (bytes +0x71, +0x70, +0x72), byte +0xb0 = evt+0x20, state name from k_Career_UpgradeStateNameTable[evt+0x28], ints +0xd8 = def+0x90, +0xdc = def+0x5c, +0xe0 = evt+0x2c, and two more enum names from evt+0x29 and evt+0x2a. Releases the shared pointer and returns 1. Good read-only hook to observe My Team upgrade events.
